name: x12-healthcare-parser
display_name: EDI X12 Healthcare Transaction and Clinical C-CDA Parser
description: EDI X12 (5010) and HL7 C-CDA XML parser for health plans, clearinghouses, and clinical billing systems.
description_for_model: Parses raw EDI X12 healthcare transaction text (270, 271, 277, 275, 278, 837, 835) and embedded C-CDA XML clinical documents into structured JSON format.

endpoints.summary: Parse raw EDI X12 text and return structured JSON
endpoints.description: Accepts a raw EDI X12 content string in the request body and returns hierarchically grouped JSON with mapped business entities, claim details, payment breakdowns, attachment flags (277), and parsed C-CDA clinical documents (275).

raw_x12.description: Complete raw EDI X12 string starting with ISA.

context.description: Optional workflow context label associated with the request.

endpoints.description: Returns the self-contained HTML, CSS, and JavaScript dashboard displaying EDI X12 to JSON semantic mappings, telemetry plots, and live stream inspection.
